blocks.raw: <Tip>The 3/2 factor in fv = 3V/(2A) is non-negotiable for rectangular timber. Forgetting it gives half the actual maximum shear stress and is unsafe.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeList mistakes={[ "Using fv = V/A instead of fv = 3V/(2A). The 3/2 factor is mandatory for rectangular sections and accounts for non-uniform shear distribution.", "Computing S = bh/6 instead of S = bh²/6. Missing the exponent on h loses the dimension entirely and gives wrong results by orders of magnitude.", "Confusing I (moment of inertia, in mm⁴) with S (section modulus, in mm³). I is for deflection; S is for bending stress.", "Applying nominal dimensions in S calculation instead of actual dimensions. Nominal 2×4 is 1.5×3.5 actual; mismatch invalidates results.", "Forgetting that allowable stresses (Fb, Fv, Fc) are tabulated, not calculated. Never derive Fb from other parameters; always look it up from a design table.", "Checking one stress (e.g., bending) and ignoring others (shear, compression). All three must pass simultaneously." ]} />
